title: Cofinal positive half-greedy skips: local exact rows and the conditional half-membership chain

concepts.label: positive half-greedy skip
concepts.note: A rank c where the rational half-greedy remainder is positive and smaller than the next Mersenne weight.

concepts.label: cofinal positive-skip supply
concepts.note: Positive half-greedy skip ranks occurring beyond every natural bound.

concepts.label: exact local Mersenne half row
concepts.note: A finite quotient row attaining the exact integral half target at its endpoint.

concepts.label: half-achievement payoff
concepts.note: Membership of one half in the closed Mersenne achievement set.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: CofinalPositiveHalfGreedySkips means that beyond every bound there is a rank c at least four where the rational half-greedy remainder after c-1 steps is positive and strictly smaller than mersenneWeightRat c.
statement_nodes.engine: cofinal supply predicate on the canonical rational half-greedy orbit
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The declaration defines the project-local open socket. The paper's equivalence audit is not a novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This declaration proves neither a cofinal supply nor an equivalence. The paper identifies the predicate with half-membership only after combining external positivity and skipped-support results; no named Lean iff with this predicate exists.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Every c at least four where the rational half-greedy remainder is positive and below the next Mersenne weight produces ExactLocalMersenneHalfRow (2c-2).
statement_nodes.engine: canonical skipped-prefix specialization of the skipped-core exact-row constructor
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a direct local specialization of the existing skipped-core constructor.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem assumes one skip event and supplies neither infinitely many events nor coherent rows. Having no capacity hypothesis at this step does not solve the global supply problem.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If positive half-greedy skips occur cofinally, the associated endpoints 2c-2 carry exact local Mersenne half rows cofinally.
statement_nodes.engine: cofinal lifting of the single-skip exact-row constructor
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a direct quantifier lift of the local producer.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem consumes the full open orbit-level supply and does not prove it.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Cofinal positive half-greedy skips yield cofinal exact rows and therefore place one half in the Mersenne achievement set.
statement_nodes.engine: cofinal exact-row approximation followed by closedness of the achievement set
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is the composition of the local cofinal producer with the existing exact-row payoff consumer.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This is only a forward conditional. It proves no half-membership, infinite support, or universal Erdős #257 result without the open antecedent; the reverse equivalence is not proved in this module.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The cofinal-row theorem takes CofinalPositiveHalfGreedySkips as its sole global hypothesis.
Each cofinal skip witness is mapped to endpoint 2c-2 by the local exact-row producer, and elementary arithmetic preserves cofinality.
The achievement-set conclusion remains conditional on the unproved cofinal positive-skip predicate.
The proof feeds the cofinal exact-row theorem into the existing cofinal-row achievement-set consumer.
